metadata.audit_title: Feature Cutoff, Real-Time Availability & Provenance Precision Audit

leakage_claim_recalibration.uncalibrated_phase_15_claim: Zero temporal leakage verified across all inputs.
leakage_claim_recalibration.calibrated_phase_16_finding: Retrospective mathematical temporal isolation is verified across all historical round indices (2021-2024 and 2025 candidate) such that feature calculations for round R strictly condition on rounds < R. However, retrospective CSV extraction from Jolpica/FastF1 does not constitute empirical proof of live API latency or real-time availability. Real-time availability is guaranteed only when the live pipeline respects Stage A (Saturday post-qualifying classification) and Stage B (Sunday pre-race FIA Starting Grid) ingestion boundaries.

grid_position.raw_source: FIA Official Starting Grid Document / Ergast/Jolpica Results table
grid_position.transformation: Integer position (1-20). Pit-lane starters capped at 20.
grid_position.missing_value_fallback: Fallback to quali_position in Stage A; error in Stage B
grid_position.earliest_legitimate_availability: Stage A: Saturday post-quali (~1-2h); Stage B: Sunday pre-race (~2h before formation lap)
grid_position.stage_eligibility: Stage A (provisional assumption) & Stage B (authoritative official grid)
grid_position.precision_statement: In retrospective historical CSVs, grid_position is extracted from Ergast/Jolpica Results tables. In live operations, Stage B requires the authoritative FIA Starting Grid document, published ~2-3 hours before race start. Stage A uses provisional qualifying classification as a proxy.

model_feature_grid_position.raw_source: Derived from official starting grid and pit-lane start status
model_feature_grid_position.earliest_legitimate_availability: Stage B: Sunday pre-race (~2h before formation lap)
model_feature_grid_position.precision_statement: Available only once pit-lane start declarations (e.g. parc ferme setup violations) are finalized by the FIA stewards prior to pit lane opening.

quali_position.earliest_legitimate_availability: Saturday ~1 hour after qualifying checkered flag
quali_position.precision_statement: Authoritatively available Saturday afternoon upon publication of the provisional qualifying classification.

grid_penalty_delta.transformation: Signed integer difference representing net grid change
grid_penalty_delta.missing_value_fallback: 0.0 in Stage A; computed in Stage B
grid_penalty_delta.earliest_legitimate_availability: Stage A: 0.0; Stage B: Sunday pre-race
grid_penalty_delta.precision_statement: In Stage A, penalties are strictly assumed to be 0.0 because the stewards' penalty grid matrix is not yet finalized. In Stage B, penalties are fully computed from the official starting grid document.

quali_time_delta_to_pole.missing_value_fallback: Median imputation for drivers without timed laps
quali_time_delta_to_pole.precision_statement: Calculated from completed Q1/Q2/Q3 lap times; fully known on Saturday.

quali_time_ratio_to_pole.precision_statement: Known on Saturday after qualifying classification.

reached_q3.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if qualified in top 10, 0.0 otherwise)
reached_q3.precision_statement: Known immediately upon conclusion of Q2.

front_row.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if starting P1 or P2, 0.0 otherwise)
front_row.earliest_legitimate_availability: Stage A: provisional front row; Stage B: official front row
front_row.precision_statement: In Stage A, reflects qualifying P1/P2; in Stage B, reflects actual starting grid P1/P2.

driver_prev_race_position.transformation: Finishing position in preceding championship round
driver_prev_race_position.precision_statement: Mathematically bounded to round < R; fully known days before the event.

driver_prev_race_points.precision_statement: Known prior to the start of the race weekend.

driver_rolling_5_win_rate.raw_source: Jolpica Results rounds R-5 to R-1
driver_rolling_5_win_rate.transformation: Proportion of wins across last 5 completed starts
driver_rolling_5_win_rate.precision_statement: Empirically verified that target round R is excluded from rolling window.

driver_season_points_before_gp.transformation: Cumulative points scored prior to round R (0.0 for Round 1)
driver_season_points_before_gp.precision_statement: Empirically verified reset to 0.0 at Round 1 across all 5 evaluated seasons.

constructor_season_points_before_gp.transformation: Cumulative constructor points prior to round R (0.0 for Round 1)
constructor_season_points_before_gp.precision_statement: Empirically verified reset to 0.0 at Round 1 across all evaluated seasons.

constructor_best_quali_delta_to_pole.precision_statement: Derived strictly from Saturday qualifying times; no Sunday race dependence.

regulation_era.precision_statement: Statutorily defined prior to season inception; zero temporal leakage risk.

quali_air_temp_c.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying
quali_air_temp_c.transformation: Mean ambient air temperature during Saturday Qualifying
quali_air_temp_c.precision_statement: Derived exclusively from Saturday qualifying weather session telemetry. Does not reflect Sunday race weather. In historical CSVs, extracted via FastF1 session weather archives.

quali_rainfall.raw_source: OpenF1 / FastF1 Weather telemetry during Qualifying
quali_rainfall.transformation: Binary indicator (1.0 if rainfall detected during qualifying, 0.0 dry)
quali_rainfall.precision_statement: Known Saturday afternoon; strictly captures qualifying conditions.

driver_substitutions.raw_source: FIA Entry List Updates / FP3 Roster changes
driver_substitutions.transformation: Substitute driver inserted with career starts/stats; replaced driver removed
driver_substitutions.earliest_legitimate_availability: Saturday pre-qualifying (or Sunday pre-race if emergency waiver granted)
driver_substitutions.stage_eligibility: Stage A (if sub occurred before quali) or Stage B (if sub occurred between quali and race)
driver_substitutions.precision_statement: Exemplified by Oliver Bearman replacing Carlos Sainz in Saudi Arabia 2024. In the retrospective dataset, Sainz is marked WITHDRAWN_BEFORE_START and Bearman has an independent 42-feature row with career starts = 0. In live operations, Stage B starting grid validation must explicitly verify active starter roster matches the FIA document.

pit_lane_starts_and_withdrawals.raw_source: FIA Parc Ferme Infringement / Pit Lane Start Notices
pit_lane_starts_and_withdrawals.transformation: Grid position mapped to 20.0; withdrawal dropped from active starters
pit_lane_starts_and_withdrawals.missing_value_fallback: 20.0 for pit lane; starter count reduced for withdrawal
pit_lane_starts_and_withdrawals.earliest_legitimate_availability: Sunday ~1 to 2 hours before race start
pit_lane_starts_and_withdrawals.precision_statement: Pit-lane starts cannot be known authoritatively at Stage A (Saturday post-qualifying) because team decisions to break parc ferme or change power unit elements typically occur Sunday morning. Stage B correctly captures pit lane starts via the official starting grid document.
